cards.title: Error spike concentrated at hour 14
cards.detail: Hour 14 recorded 1,460 errors in 9,225 requests, a 15.8% error rate. This hour accounts for 67.3% of all 2,169 weekly errors, versus 31 errors in each other high-volume hour.

cards.title: model-epsilon failed every request
cards.detail: model-epsilon returned 40 errors from 40 requests, a 100% error rate. Investigate its configuration or routing before additional traffic is sent to it.

cards.title: caller-07 has disproportionate spend per request
cards.detail: caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests: 5.2% of $3,354.82 total spend from 0.6% of 204,993 requests. Its spend per request is $0.148, versus $0.016 across all traffic.

cards.title: Ten callers have persistently low cache-hit rates
cards.detail: callers 03, 05, 07, 09, 11, 13, 15, 17, 21, and 23 handled 44,951 requests, 21.9% of traffic, while their cache-hit rates were only 3.7% to 8.9%. Review cache keys, request reuse, and cache eligibility for this cohort.

cards.title: model-alpha has the highest p95 latency at substantial volume
cards.detail: model-alpha processed 86,080 requests, 42.0% of total traffic, with a p95 latency of 2,454 ms. This is 225 ms higher than model-beta's 2,229 ms p95 and 1,144 ms higher than model-gamma's 1,310 ms p95.
